import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_ids = set(feats.ids)
    corr_pairs = [
        ("LBV14", "BRF16"), ("FWIC14", "DNM11"), ("NXUR3", "DLW17"),
        ("RQV6", "LBV14"), ("WUY9", "BRF16"), ("FWIC14", "DXJE5"),
        ("DXJE5", "DNM11"), ("LBV14", "NHR5"), ("CWWV6B", "LBV14"),
        ("WUY9", "LBV14"), ("EOEY11", "SOKH19"), ("LBV14", "KBJO11"),
        ("MCZ2A", "RFIQ18"), ("BRF16", "NHR5"), ("RQV6", "NHR5"),
        ("CWWV6B", "BRF16"), ("KHP6", "IMJ11"), ("CWWV6B", "CMGZ19A"),
        ("WUY9", "DNM11"), ("RQV6", "BRF16")
    ]
    
    # Remove one from each highly correlated pair
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        if a in keep_ids and b in keep_ids:
            # Prefer the one with higher t-statistic
            ta = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:, feats.column(a)], feats.y)[0])
            tb = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:, feats.column(b)], feats.y)[0])
            if ta > tb:
                keep_ids.remove(b)
            else:
                keep_ids.remove(a)
    
    # Calculate effect sizes and select top candidates
    effects = []
    for fid in keep_ids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        # Use t-test statistic as effect size measure
        effect = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:, col], feats.y)[0])
        effects.append((fid, effect))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top drivers (max 4 as per checker report)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _ in effects[:4]]
    
    # If no strong drivers, return empty design
    if not drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build regression features (include only drivers)
    columns = drivers
    
    # Create products for top pairs
    products = []
    if len(drivers) >= 2:
        # Include interaction between top two drivers
        products = [(drivers[0], drivers[1])]
    
    # Simple weighted score using top features
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(drivers):
        loadings[fid] = 1.0 / (i + 1)  # Weight decreases with rank
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(columns), products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
